description: Healthy adult reference assembled from measured means and explicitly labeled model approximations; not a single normative population or a validated clinical model. Shape, mass, inertia and joint ordering remain the upstream SMPL proxy.

CDC2011.cohort: Healthy ages 20-44; arithmetic mean of published female and male ROM means; not a pooled population mean.

MORIN2023.cohort: 30 healthy adults, 17 men/13 women, 21-69 y, mean 41.3 y, mean mass 71.8 kg; convenience sample.

DANNESKIOLD2009.cohort: Youngest group 20-29 y, 18 women/10 men; equal-sex average of isometric means, not isokinetic values.
DANNESKIOLD2009.location: Results: shoulder adduction, trunk, hip adduction, ankle plantarflexion; narrative explicitly specifies Nm

SILDER2007.cohort: 20 healthy young adults, 9 men/11 women, sex-specific mean ages 26.1/25.5 y.
SILDER2007.location: Table 4 mean coefficients and Appendix A; five uniarticular terms plus rectus femoris and hamstrings; gastrocnemius excluded

FORMICA2012.cohort: 10 healthy right-handed adults, 7 men/3 women, mean age 30 y, range 24-42 y.
FORMICA2012.location: Table 2 total means, radial/ulnar deviation and pronation/supination stiffness

NGUYEN2020.cohort: 25-45 y stratum, 37 women/41 men; equal-sex mean. Relaxed wrist, small oscillations +/-10 degrees, 3-12 Hz.
NGUYEN2020.location: Table 2: female/male flexion 89.89/85.29 deg, extension 68.27/68.19 deg; EL 1.64/2.22 Nm/rad; VI 1.89/2.56 Nms/rad

KOYKKA2025.cohort: 35 physically active adults, 20 men/15 women, age 30 +/-7 y; non-dominant means applied bilaterally.
KOYKKA2025.location: Table 2: mean of test/retest, pronation 8.68/8.88 Nm; supination 9.77/9.79 Nm

NIEWIADOMSKI2019.cohort: 97 no current neck pain volunteers, mean age 28.3 y; some past neck pain.
NIEWIADOMSKI2019.location: Abstract, after outlier exclusions: total flexion-extension 127.4 deg, lateral inclinations 89.3 deg, rotations 146.4 deg. Symmetric split and equal Neck/Head allocation are assumptions.

ASSUMPTION.location: Engineering approximation, NOT a measured healthy adult mean. See README assumptions.

UNMEASURED.location: No defensible coefficient selected: zero central stiffness/damping is omission, not evidence of zero tissue resistance.

PROXY.location: Borrowed measured torque from another direction/DOF; not a measured mean for this DOF. See joint note.

L_Hip_x.note: Positive clinical direction: abduction. Abduction MORIN2023; adduction DANNESKIOLD2009 (124+217)/2. ROM is an engineering bound.

L_Hip_y.note: Negative flexion, positive extension; nonlinear passive model SILDER2007.

L_Hip_z.note: Positive clinical direction: external rotation; isolated angular bounds, no posture-dependent coupling.

L_Knee_x.note: Hinge-knee approximation: near-lock secondary axes; preserves action indices, omits physiological knee rotation/translation.

L_Knee_y.note: Positive flexion; nonlinear passive model SILDER2007.

L_Knee_z.note: Hinge-knee approximation: near-lock secondary axes; preserves action indices, omits physiological knee rotation/translation.

L_Ankle_x.note: Positive clinical direction: inversion. MORIN2023 eversion torque used for both directions; ROM assumed.

L_Ankle_y.note: Negative dorsiflexion MORIN2023; positive plantarflexion DANNESKIOLD2009 (94.6+142)/2. Nonlinear passive plantarflexor SILDER2007.

L_Ankle_z.note: Near-lock redundant axial foot rotation; subtalar coupling not represented.

L_Toe_y.note: Single lumped MTP proxy; ROM and strength assumed, not toe or finger norms.

R_Hip_x.note: Positive clinical direction: abduction. Abduction MORIN2023; adduction DANNESKIOLD2009 (124+217)/2. ROM is an engineering bound.

R_Hip_y.note: Negative flexion, positive extension; nonlinear passive model SILDER2007.

R_Hip_z.note: Positive clinical direction: external rotation; isolated angular bounds, no posture-dependent coupling.

R_Knee_x.note: Hinge-knee approximation: near-lock secondary axes; preserves action indices, omits physiological knee rotation/translation.

R_Knee_y.note: Positive flexion; nonlinear passive model SILDER2007.

R_Knee_z.note: Hinge-knee approximation: near-lock secondary axes; preserves action indices, omits physiological knee rotation/translation.

R_Ankle_x.note: Positive clinical direction: inversion. MORIN2023 eversion torque used for both directions; ROM assumed.

R_Ankle_y.note: Negative dorsiflexion MORIN2023; positive plantarflexion DANNESKIOLD2009 (94.6+142)/2. Nonlinear passive plantarflexor SILDER2007.

R_Ankle_z.note: Near-lock redundant axial foot rotation; subtalar coupling not represented.

R_Toe_y.note: Single lumped MTP proxy; ROM and strength assumed, not toe or finger norms.

Torso_x.note: Trunk lateral bend: total +/-35 deg equally split across 3 joints; 60 Nm assumed at each series joint.

Torso_y.note: Positive trunk flexion. ROM aggregate -25..60 deg assumed, divided by 3. Mean extension (232+336)/2, flexion (96.5+147)/2 Nm; same torque at each series joint, not divided by 3.

Torso_z.note: Trunk axial rotation +/-45 deg split by 3; 40 Nm strength assumed.

Spine_x.note: Trunk lateral bend: total +/-35 deg equally split across 3 joints; 60 Nm assumed at each series joint.

Spine_y.note: Positive trunk flexion. ROM aggregate -25..60 deg assumed, divided by 3. Mean extension (232+336)/2, flexion (96.5+147)/2 Nm; same torque at each series joint, not divided by 3.

Spine_z.note: Trunk axial rotation +/-45 deg split by 3; 40 Nm strength assumed.

Chest_x.note: Trunk lateral bend: total +/-35 deg equally split across 3 joints; 60 Nm assumed at each series joint.

Chest_y.note: Positive trunk flexion. ROM aggregate -25..60 deg assumed, divided by 3. Mean extension (232+336)/2, flexion (96.5+147)/2 Nm; same torque at each series joint, not divided by 3.

Chest_z.note: Trunk axial rotation +/-45 deg split by 3; 40 Nm strength assumed.

Neck_x.note: Aggregate cervical ROM symmetrically split across directions and Neck/Head. Strength assumed.

Neck_y.note: Positive flexion. Symmetric split of total measured cervical ROM; extension/flexion strength assumed.

Neck_z.note: Aggregate cervical rotation symmetrically split; strength assumed.

Head_x.note: Aggregate cervical ROM symmetrically split across directions and Neck/Head. Strength assumed.

Head_y.note: Positive flexion. Symmetric split of total measured cervical ROM; extension/flexion strength assumed.

Head_z.note: Aggregate cervical rotation symmetrically split; strength assumed.

L_Thorax_x.note: Lumped shoulder-girdle proxy, not an independent measured joint. ROM and strength assumed.

L_Thorax_y.note: Lumped shoulder-girdle proxy, not an independent measured joint. ROM and strength assumed.

L_Thorax_z.note: Lumped shoulder-girdle proxy, not an independent measured joint. ROM and strength assumed.

L_Shoulder_x.note: T-pose has 90 deg elevation; clinical elevation=q*s+90. Abduction MORIN2023; adduction DANNESKIOLD2009 (42+89.6)/2. Total elevation 0-180 assumed; girdle motion can add to it.

L_Shoulder_y.note: Positive clinical direction: external humeral rotation, after elevation; rectangular ROM is a surrogate.

L_Shoulder_z.note: With arm down, negative clinical direction flexion (CDC2011 170.4); extension 60 assumed. MORIN2023 flexion torque also used as unmeasured extension proxy.

L_Elbow_x.note: Near-lock secondary elbow axes. Forearm pronation/supination assigned to Wrist_y, to avoid rotating the elbow flexion plane.

L_Elbow_y.note: Near-lock secondary elbow axes. Forearm pronation/supination assigned to Wrist_y, to avoid rotating the elbow flexion plane.

L_Elbow_z.note: Negative clinical direction: elbow flexion. Zero central passive coefficient means unmodeled, not physiologically absent.

L_Wrist_x.note: Negative clinical direction: wrist flexion. Neutral T-pose palms downward; small-amplitude stiffness/damping extrapolated to full ROM.

L_Wrist_y.note: Positive clinical direction: supination, negative pronation. Distal lumped radioulnar rotation; forearm inertia/geometry do not rotate with this surrogate.

L_Wrist_z.note: Negative clinical direction: radial deviation; positive ulnar. ROM assumed; extension/flexion MORIN2023 torques borrowed as radial/ulnar proxies.

L_Hand_x.note: Rigid distal-hand approximation, no independent finger model; no duplicated wrist strength.
